records.title: Collision coverage
records.text: We will pay for direct and accidental loss to your covered auto caused by collision with another object or by upset, less the applicable deductible, up to the actual cash value of the auto at the time of loss.

records.title: Deductible
records.text: The deductible shown in the declarations applies separately to each covered loss. Our payment is the amount of the covered loss minus the deductible.

records.title: Comprehensive (other than collision) coverage
records.text: We will pay for direct and accidental loss to your covered auto not caused by collision, including glass breakage, hail, theft and vandalism, less the applicable deductible.

records.title: Total loss
records.text: If the cost to repair the covered auto equals or exceeds its actual cash value, the auto is a total loss. A total loss is settled at actual cash value, less the deductible, following valuation by an appraiser.

records.title: Bodily injury claims handling
records.text: Any claim involving bodily injury to any person shall be handled by an injury specialist. No settlement of the property element may proceed in a way that prejudices the injury claim.

records.title: Policy period
records.text: This policy applies only to losses that occur during the policy period shown in the declarations. Coverage begins at 00:01 local time on the start date and ends at 23:59 local time on the end date. We have no duty to pay for any loss outside the policy period.

records.title: Fraud indicators and referral
records.text: Where the claim file contains material inconsistencies, including documents dated before the reported loss, evidence relating to a different vehicle, or medical records inconsistent with the reported incident, the claim shall be referred to the special investigations unit before any payment.

records.title: Theft reporting
records.text: A theft of the covered auto must be reported to the police promptly. We will not settle a theft claim until a police report reference has been provided.

records.title: Commercial use exclusion
records.text: We do not provide coverage for any loss while the covered auto is being used to carry persons or property for compensation or a fee, including transportation network (rideshare) or delivery services, unless the declarations show a commercial use class.

records.title: Settlement authority
records.text: Any settlement with a net payable amount above $25,000 requires sign-off by a senior adjuster before it may be approved.

records.title: Renewal
records.text: Coverage continues beyond the end date only when the renewal has been processed and the renewal premium received. A renewal submitted but not yet processed at the time of loss is subject to underwriting confirmation.

records.title: Liability-only scope
records.text: If the declarations show liability coverage only, this policy provides no coverage for loss or damage to your own auto.
